title: Making some progress!
author: DamnGoodGames
selftext:
Hello, this morning I pushed an update to my game and I am finally not embarrassed about it. You play as an FPV pilot capturing footage of deadly, deadly races. I got the idea watching motorcross when a drone was following a rider I particularly hate and I thought "What if this dickhead just got hit with a missile?" and now here we are. I would love to get some feedback, no matter what kind.

I used Claude cowork and recently started using the godot-mcp.

Thanks!

[https://dangood.itch.io/deathrace-fanbase](https://dangood.itch.io/deathrace-fanbase)
